verification.statistic: median over the five rounds of each round's median
verification.charge_rule: the cost units of a signature that the Ed25519 precompile verifies, times the ratio of the two times
verification.library: fips204 0.5.0 (ML-DSA-44, public key decoded for every verification), ed25519-dalek 2 (verify_strict)

first.what: the migration takes every entry byte and cost unit that ordinary traffic leaves under the block limits

second.what: as the first, and the migration takes no more entry bytes in a block than that block's ordinary traffic

rates_by_charge_per_verification.charge: 30 cost units per microsecond of the time on the run's machine

order_of_inclusion.source: core/src/transaction_priority.rs, Agave v4.4.1: priority = reward x 1,000,000 / (1 + cost at the limits asked for), rounded down

tips.what: increase of the balance of one of Jito's eight tip accounts (data/jito_tip_accounts.json) by a transaction

population_sources.name: Glassnode Studio, Solana address counts by balance
population_sources.value_used: the figure labelled "in the last 24 hours" in the block "LATEST VALUES" of each page; the pages state no date for it
population_sources.what_is_counted: unique addresses holding at least the stated amount of SOL; every kind of address, not only key-controlled wallets, so each count is an upper bound for wallets
